leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a sandboxed environment using iframe isolation techniques
Implement a secure message-passing interface between parent window and sandbox
Configure a restricted eval function that prevents access to global objects
Apply input sanitization to filter potentially dangerous code patterns
Initialize a code execution controller with timeout and error boundaries
Integrate a result validation layer to verify output safety
Manipulate the execution context to limit available APIs and methods
lessonTitle: Build sandboxed code runner safe eval strategy
